name: safetyx1_prefx05_sky_x05_small
description: A small subset from the Safety X1 preference-style dataset collection used to train and evaluate reward/preference models. It contains human preference comparisons intended to measure model alignment and safety-related ranking behavior. The benchmark focuses on safety-related text preferences and is typically used to compute preference-accuracy of models or to train reward models.
reputation: Part of the multilingual-reward-bench family aimed at safety/alignment research; recognized within alignment research circles but not broadly adopted outside that community.
